name: Genome-Wide Association Identifies the First Risk Loci for Psychosis in Alzheimer Disease
description: Genome-wide association meta-analysis of Alzheimer’s disease (AD) subjects (N=12,317) classified as psychosis-positive (AD+P) or psychosis-negative (AD-P) based on delusions and/or hallucinations. Eight program sources contributed whole blood, DNA, SNP array data, or genome-wide association statistics; data were processed as four cohorts (Phase 1, Phase 2, GR@ACE, NEXGENS). Cohort GWAS contrasted AD+P versus AD-P using PLINK logistic regression with ancestry covariate adjustment (and sex as an additional covariate for chromosome X), and results were meta-analyzed using METAL; NEXGENS contributed summary statistics from consortium datasets.
